source: Zhang et al. (2024), results of RQ1.xlsx
snippet: whole function play_room, lines 302 to 401 of the original
removed_from_original: lines 1 to 65, header: author, date, solution of the game and the sentence 'Program written with A LOT OF HELP from Github CoPilot'.
os.system('') at import time (it only enables ANSI colors in the Windows console): side effect with no role in the tested behavior.
comments 'by github copilot' above the screen functions (outside the snippet).
rooms the tests do not use, show_introduction, player_dies, player_wins, play_again and the main loop of the module.
scaffolding: Index constants, new_line, closet_action and piano_action copied from the original.
move_cursor, clear_screen, clear_to_end_of_screen, clear_to_end_of_line, colorize, show_error and get_room_data copied from the original.

room_data with two rooms of the original (basement_dark and upstairs_unlocked), same texts, built with the function _action and one variable per room instead of the nested literal of the original, which would trigger MNC in the scaffolding. A _room with 5 parameters was tried and triggered LPL; discarded.
Checked: Pysmell only flags the LM of the snippet.

side_effects.description: The snippet prints with ANSI codes, reads with input(), pauses with time.sleep() and exits with exit() if the room does not exist.
side_effects.handling: The test replaces input() and time.sleep() with doubles through monkeypatch and expects SystemExit; the snippet was not changed.

pinned_behavior: typical: first room, option 4: exact printed text (colors and cursor), pause of 0.5 s, one question, returns ['basement_light', 'The lights are now on.'].
edge: room without a description and with a previous message (pause of 1 s); 'h' shows the hint, 9 and 'x' are refused, option 2 only shows the message and 'q' returns ['player_quits', ''].
invalid: a nonexistent room prints the error and raises SystemExit, without asking anything.
not_pinned_on_purpose: Which of the four opening sentences is drawn in the rooms after the first: the test accepts any of them, without pinning how the draw is made (random.randrange in the original).

adaptation_check.snippet_diff: identical to the original (lines 302 to 401 against 113 to 212 of the unit)
adaptation_check.pysmell: LM detected, MLOC=54, same as the original; nothing in the scaffolding
